examples.en: "Unless we accept that obesity is a disease, we are not going to be able to tackle it," he concludes.
examples.zh: “除非我们承认肥胖是一种疾病，否则我们将无法解决它。”他总结道。

examples.en: The research concludes that, contrary to popular belief, people with red hair do not bleed any more than other patients.
examples.zh: 研究得出的结论与普遍的看法相反，红头发的人并不比其他病人出血多。

examples.en: Little wonder the latest survey concludes that the extent and type of hospital teaching available differ a great deal across the country.
examples.zh: 难怪最近的调查得出结论，医院教学的范围和类型在全国各地差别很大。
